title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

Preferred Skills:

Leadership Skills:

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced Payroll Project Manager to lead the end-to-end implementation of Client’s new payroll system and service model. You will serve as the primary bridge between Client’s internal stakeholders (HR, Finance, IT), local partner and Neeyamo implementation teams. provider’s project team to track progress and unblock issues.

provider’s platform, ensuring 100% accuracy in employee records and year-to-date balances.

 Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to automate workflows between HRIS and the

new payroll platform to reduce manual intervention.

 Risk Mitigation: Maintain a Risk & Issue Log, proactively identifying bottlenecks that could

delay the 10-month timeline.

 Planning : Compliance: Support future implementation planning, prepare Wave Plans, and

ensure adherence to project management frameworks


Qualifications & Skills

 Experience: 7+ years in Payroll implementations &; project management or HR Project

Management, with at least 2 successful large-scale payroll implementations.

 Local Expertise: Knowledge of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and the eSocial framework is

beneficial.

 Language : Fluency in Portuguese and English (required for global reporting).

 Technical Savvy : Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana) and

advanced Excel. Experience/ knowledge on any Ewaider& ;Co suite of products will be an

additional advantage.

 Communication: Strong negotiation skills to manage vendor performance and expectations.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: DevOps Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como:

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando processos de integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações.
  • Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.


Resultados esperados incluem a otimização do tempo de desenvolvimento, a redução do tempo de lançamento de nova versões em produção e a melhoria contínua do processo de entrega de software. Exemplos de entregáveis incluem a configuração e manutenção de ambientes de infraestrutura cloud, o desenvolvimento de scripts de automação de tarefas e pipelines de CI/CD, além da resolução de incidentes e problemas de produção.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis
  • Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com a prática de infraestrutura como código, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation e/ou Azure Resource Manager para provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud.

title: Account Executive - B2B SaaS
description:
About the Role

We’re hiring high-performing B2B SaaS Account Executives based in LATAM who want full ownership of their number and unlimited earning potential.

This is a role for builders, not order-takers. You’ll own the entire sales cycle, work directly with US-based customers, and be rewarded on performance. If you believe sales is the fastest path to growth, autonomy, and income, this role is for you.


About Lilo

Lilo is rebuilding procurement for Commercial Real Estate using AI.

Hotels and CRE operators still manage procurement with emails, calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Lilo replaces that chaos with a single AI-powered platform that automates purchasing, vendor management, invoice processing, and price optimization.

We work with major hotel management companies and staple hotel brands in the US, and we’re in an explosive growth path. Top performers have outsized impact and ownership.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the entire outbound sales motion : prospecting, discovery, demo, close with US-based customers
  • Represent Lilo at industry events and network your way to high profile decision makers
  • Build and manage a pipeline of C-level operators, hotel owners, and decision-makers
  • Navigate consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Work closely with onboarding and product to ensure long-term customer success


What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent written and spoken English (C2 level)
  • Up to 5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales (closing role, not SDR-only)
  • Proven track record owning full sales cycles
  • Strong outbound prospecting skills (email, LinkedIn, calls)
  • Experience selling to US-based customers
  • Comfortable working remotely with high independence
  • Competitive, performance-driven mindset


Compensation & Upside

  • Base salary: US$2,500/Mo.
  • On Target Commission: $2,500+/Mo. (50/50 split)
  • Total OTE: $5,000+/Mo.
  • Uncapped commissions + boosters
  • ESOP package with high potential upside

The harder you grind, the more you make.


Who Should NOT Apply

This role is not for you if:

  • You are not confident selling in English to US customers
  • You want a passive, inbound-only sales role
  • You need heavy structure, scripts, or constant supervision
  • You’re uncomfortable picking up the phone, doing outbound outreach, and rejection
  • You’re looking for a slow-moving, corporate environment


Why Lilo?

  • Fully remote role with a fast-growing, US-based startup
  • USD compensation with uncapped upside
  • Direct exposure to high profile US-based customers
  • Fast-moving startup with real ownership and accountability
  • Early-stage opportunity with real revenue ownership and ESOP upside
  • Performance-first compensation with uncapped upside
  • Ambitious, low-ego, execution-focused team
  • Exposure to AI, SaaS, and hospitality at scale

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .

  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.

Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (Node.js/TypeScript)
description:
Quem somos?


Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto - SP, com a missão de tornar as organizações da saúde mais eficientes, possibilitando a melhor assistência aos pacientes. Queremos ser reconhecidos como uma das maiores provedoras de serviços de informações a operadores de saúde!


No nosso ambiente de trabalho, procuramos sempre agir com base nos nossos valores. É através deles que chegaremos mais perto de alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Pense grande;
  • Excelente não é suficiente;
  • Fail fast, learn faster;
  • Inovar para revolucionar;
  • Simples sempre;
  • Só é bom pra gente se for bom pro cliente;


Qual o desafio?


Buscamos uma pessoa com visão arquitetural e experiência em alta escalabilidade para elevar o nível técnico do nosso time. Você terá papel fundamental na definição de padrões de engenharia e na construção de sistemas robustos que impactam diretamente a eficiência do setor de saúde.


O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?


Sua missão vai além de escrever código: você será uma referência técnica dentro da Carefy.


  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


Qual o contexto?


Você fará parte do nosso time de integração. Somos os responsáveis pela interoperabilidade da Carefy. Nossa missão é conectar nossa plataforma aos ecossistemas heterogêneos das operadoras de saúde, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance. Neste time, você atuará como referência técnica : participando diretamente do desenho de soluções junto aos times de TI dos clientes e, internamente, traduzindo esses desafios complexos em uma arquitetura limpa e em demandas organizadas para orientar o desenvolvimento.


O que esperamos de você?


  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de enxergar o impacto de uma decisão técnica em todo o ecossistema do produto.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade de negociar soluções técnicas com clientes externos e guiar o time interno com clareza.
  • Autonomia com Responsabilidade: Habilidade para tocar projetos complexos com pouca supervisão, gerenciando riscos.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz e em soluções definitivas.


Quais são os requisitos?


  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem e otimização;
  • Experiência comprovada com Arquitetura de Software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD);
  • Experiência prática com Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e serviços de Mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka) ;
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs RESTful escaláveis;
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta criticidade e volume de dados;
  • Domínio de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.js ;
  • Conhecimento prático em testes automatizados (TDD , testes unitários e de integração);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


Será um diferencial:


  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


O que oferecemos?


  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!


Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

title: Senior Elixir Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking:


We’re looking for a talented and experienced Elixir Backend Developer to join our international team and help design, build, and harden our agentic contracts execution layer —the platform where autonomous/agent-driven workflows orchestrate and execute contractual logic reliably, at scale. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. You’ll work on resilient OTP services, job orchestration, stateful workflows, and observability to ensure correctness, auditability, and performance. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work


Your Role and Responsibilities:  

  • Design and implement Elixir/OTP services (GenServer, Supervision trees, Registries) that power contract execution and agentic workflows.
  • Own the lifecycle of long-running, event-driven workflows (timers, scheduling, compensations/Saga patterns, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).
  • Develop secure APIs and integrations, rate limiting, and request budgets for agent calls.
  • Optimize performance (ETS, streams, batching, backpressure) and observability (tracing, metrics, structured logs).
  • Collaborate with Product and AI/Agent teams to translate requirements into deterministic, testable contract execution flows.
  • Write high-quality tests, migrations, and production-grade documentation.


Tech You’ll Use:

  • Elixir /OTP (GenServer, Supervisors, Applications), Phoenix (APIs), Ecto (PostgreSQL), Oban, OpenTelemetry/PromEx
  • Message brokers & streams: Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Container & cloud: Docker , Kubernetes , AWS/GCP/Azure
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (or similar), feature flags, migrations & rollout strategies


Essential Qualifications:  

  • 3+ years building production Elixir/OTP services (or 5+ years BE + 1–2 years Elixir with strong OTP fundamentals).
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, supervision strategies, and fault tolerance on the BEAM.
  • Solid experience with Ecto/MySQL , schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Practical knowledge of job orchestration (Oban or equivalent), idempotency, retries, and backpressure.
  • Proven track record in building and maintaining event-driven or workflow systems with strong correctness guarantees.
  • Comfortable with containerized deployments and CI/CD; you ship and you own.
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily collaboration in English).


Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.


What We Offer:


  • Contract-based hiring;

  • 100% remote work / home office;

  • Open and flexible time-off policy;
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment;

AI & GPU Platform Support

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.

description:

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, criar uma arquitetura e pipeline de dados para: ingestão e ETL na cloud AWS e GCP.
  • Modelar e/ou otimizar estruturas de dados utilizando banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Implementar processos de ELT para consolidar dados de múltiplas fontes(internos e externos) com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Implementar práticas de segurança e conformidade (LGPD, GDPR, ou outras) para proteção de dados sensíveis, incluindo criptografia e controle de acesso.
  • Garantir qualidade, governança e rastreabilidade dos dados em todo ciclo de vida.
  • Colaborar com uma equipe multidisciplinar de Devs, PMs, Tech Leads e Staffs para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções de ponta-a-ponta.


Requisitos:

  • Formação acadêmica em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Economia, ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos como Engenheiro de Dados ou em funções similares
  • Fortes conhecimentos em conceitos de data warehousing, data lakes, processos ETL, e data modeling (OLAP e OLTP).
  • Conhecimentos sólidos dos componentes da AWS para armazenamento e processamento de dados. (Postgres, RedShift, Kinesis, Lambdas, AWS Glue etc) e GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage etc)
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiente em SQL e experiência com linguagens como Python e frameworks de processamento(Spark,Flink).
  • Vivência com frameworks de transformação de dados como DBT Core e ferramentas de orquestração como Apache Airflow.
  • Experiência com SaaS e na construção de indicadores de negócio.


Desejável:

  • Experiência prévia em ambiente SaaS;
  • Conhecimento de governança de dados
  • Ter trabalhado com AWS GLUE, Dbt e BigQuery.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ

  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados Sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora

title: Azure Windows Solutions Architect
description:
Lead Azure & Windows Infrastructure Architect (POD 1 & 2)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 13+ Years | Level: C5/C6 (Senior Leadership)

The Challenge

Are you a master of Windows ecosystems ready to lead the charge into the Cloud? We are looking for a Lead Infrastructure Architect to spearhead large-scale migrations for high-stakes industries like Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

In this role, you aren’t just a designer—you are the General of our Cloud PODs. You will lead a technical team of 5+ engineers, ensuring that complex legacy environments are modernized, secured, and migrated to Azure with surgical precision.

Your Impact

  • Architectural Sovereignty: Design the end-to-end \"Target State\" for massive enterprise environments. You will own the HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) , ensuring every VM, Cluster, and Network packet has its place.
  • Lead the Squad: Act as the technical North Star for a team of 5+ infra experts. You will guide, govern, and mentor your team to deliver excellence under pressure.
  • Windows Modernization: You are the expert who knows Windows Clustering, DFS, and File/Print Services inside out. You’ll be the one to solve the \"impossible\" legacy issues during migration.
  • The Business Brain: You don't just build; you justify. You’ll use TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI metrics to prove to stakeholders that your architecture is the most efficient and cost-effective solution.
  • Mission Critical Support: You will oversee the stability of the environment, ensuring 24/7 reliability through robust Backup, DR, and Monitoring solutions.

What You Bring to the Table

  • The Veteran Background: 13+ years in IT with a deep focus on Windows Server and Azure IaaS/PaaS .
  • Migration Mastery: Expert-level experience with Azure Migrate for server consolidation and workload shifts.
  • Networking & Identity Guru: Deep knowledge of DNS, DHCP, WINS, and Azure IAM/Key Vault to keep our Landing Zones secure and connected.
  • Resilience Expert: Hands-on experience with Windows Clustering and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) for business continuity.
  • Strategic Communicator: You can navigate a 24x7 shift environment, manage customer calls with poise, and present complex solutions to C-suite stakeholders.

The Toolkit

  • Core: Azure Infrastructure, Windows Server (all versions), Azure Networking.
  • Leadership: Team Management & Technical Governance.
  • Compliance: Experience in regulated domains (SIAM, Data Privacy, Financial regulations).
  • Certifications (Preferred): AZ-305 (Solutions Architect Expert) or AZ-104 .

Why This Role?

This is more than a migration job; it’s a leadership opportunity. You will own the strategy for POD 1 and 2 , deciding how global enterprises evolve. If you enjoy solving complex \"under-the-hood\" Windows issues while simultaneously designing high-level cloud strategies, this is your next career move.

Ready to lead the migration? Apply now and let’s build the future of Enterprise Cloud.

What makes this version effective?

  • Directly addresses the \"POD\" structure: It makes the candidate feel like they are leading a specific mission.
  • Highlights the Hybrid nature: It acknowledges that they need to be good at both the new (Azure) and the old (Windows Clustering/DFS).
  • Emphasizes Leadership: By using words like \"General\" and \"North Star,\" you attract people who want to manage teams, not just configurations.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Azure SQL Solutions Architect (Level P5/P6/P7)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 15+ Years | Sector: Enterprise Cloud Transformation

The Mission

Are you a visionary architect who lives at the intersection of Data and Infrastructure ? We are looking for a heavy-hitter to lead massive, high-stakes cloud migrations for some of the world’s largest brands in Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

As our SQL Architect , you aren't just moving databases; you are reimagining how global enterprises operate in the cloud. You will be the technical authority responsible for auditing complex legacy environments and architecting the future-state of Azure Data & Infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the Future: Conduct deep-dive \"AS-IS\" assessments and design sophisticated \"Target State\" architectures that get approved by executive review boards.
  • Lead the Migration: Drive large-scale Azure migration activities, utilizing Azure Migrate to move complex on-prem workloads to the cloud.
  • Master the Landing Zone: Design and build secure, scalable Azure Landing Zones from the ground up, ensuring identity (IAM), security (Key Vault), and governance are baked-in.
  • Blueprint Excellence: Produce high-fidelity HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) documents covering the entire Azure ecosystem.
  • Be the Expert: Provide technical leadership in troubleshooting deep-stack issues (Networking, IO, Clusters) and define the BoM (Bill of Materials) to ensure clients get maximum value for their investment.

What We’re Looking For

  • The Veteran: 15+ years of IT experience, with at least a decade dedicated to the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
  • The SQL Specialist: Deep, hands-on mastery of Azure SQL (IaaS & PaaS) , Azure Storage, and high-availability data solutions.
  • The Strategist: Experience in Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BCDR) and infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • The Communicator: Ability to bridge the gap between deep technical troubleshooting and C-suite stakeholder management.
  • The Industry Expert: Previous success navigating the regulatory complexities of the Banking or Healthcare sectors.

Technical Toolkit

  • Primary: Azure SQL, Azure Migrate, IAM, Key Vault, Storage.
  • Architecture: Mastery of Frameworks (TOGAF or similar), HLD/LLD creation.
  • Certification (The Cherry on Top): AZ-305 (Infrastructure Solutions) or AZ-104 (Administrator).

Why Join Us?

You will work on projects of massive scale where your designs directly impact the security and efficiency of global financial and medical data. This is a role for an architect who wants to own the \"Big Picture\" while staying sharp on the technical details.

Ready to build the next generation of Cloud Infrastructure? Let’s talk.

title: Analista Sênior de PLD/FTP – (Foco em CVM & Sistema de monitoramento - FIRA)
description:
Sobre a oportunidade:


Buscamos um(a) Analista Sênior de PLD/FTP para atuar no time de Monitoramento, com papel estratégico na análise de transações, mitigação de riscos e fortalecimento da governança no tema Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro. Principais responsabilidades:

  • Executar os processos de PLD/FTP , incluindo comunicação ao Coaf ;
  • Contribuir para a avaliação e aprimoramento das regras de monitoramento ;
  • Apoiar a atualização de políticas, manuais e procedimentos de PLD/FTP;
  • Acompanhar apontamentos e planos de ação de inspeções e auditorias (internas e externas);
  • Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe de Monitoramento e pares;
  • Interagir com áreas internas, promovendo alinhamento e fortalecimento da cultura de Conheça seu Cliente e Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro.


Perfil técnico, comportamental e diferenciais:


  • Sólida experiência em monitoramento de operações e análise de transações suspeitas e atípicas ;
  • Certificações ABT1 e PQO – Compliance (obrigatórias) ;
  • Conhecimento da regulamentação de PLD/FTP, como por exemplo: (Resolução CVM nº 50, Resolução CVM nº 44, Resolução CVM nº 35, (Lei nº 9.613/98, Circular Bacen nº 3.978, Carta Circular nº 4.001;
  • Pacote Office intermediário ;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com autonomia para priorização e tomada de decisão ;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de PLD/FTP (e-Guardian, FIRA, Neoway e World-Check e demais birôs reputacionais e ferramentas especialistas);
  • Certificações adicionais como IPLD e/ou ACAMS ;
  • Vivência com monitoramento de diferentes produtos financeiros.


Informações adicionais:


No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.


Benefícios que Valorizam Você:


  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados: Mediante resultados do banco, conforme convenção coletiva.
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Cobertura completa para cuidados médicos e odontológicos de qualidade.
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche: Apoio financeiro para conciliar trabalho e responsabilidades familiares.
  • Apoio à Educação: Suporte para desenvolvimento acadêmico e profissional, investindo no seu desenvolvimento.
  • Parcerias com Desconto: Vantagens exclusivas em uma variedade de produtos e serviços por meio de parcerias estratégicas.
  • Folga assiduidade: Um dia livre para recarregar energias e equilibrar responsabilidades
  • Totalpass - Incentivo à Saúde: Acesso a uma ampla rede de atividades físicas, promovendo um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.


Estamos cheios de desafios, e convidamos você a fazer parte dessa jornada de sucesso, onde #vemserDaycoval é mais do que um convite, é um chamado para fazer história.

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Assistente Administrativo


A Patrimonial Segurança é uma empresa especializada na proteção patrimonial, consolidada como referência no setor de segurança privada na região de Santa Catarina. Com uma trajetória marcada pela excelência e inovação, a empresa oferece soluções completas e personalizadas para atender às necessidades de segurança de seus clientes, sejam eles residenciais, comerciais ou industriais.

A atuação da Patrimonial Segurança é pautada em três pilares fundamentais:


· Tecnologia Avançada: Utilizando equipamentos modernos, sistemas de monitoramento eletrônico, alarmes e controle de acesso, a empresa garante um alto nível de eficiência no combate a incidentes.

· Equipe Altamente Capacitada: Os profissionais da Patrimonial Segurança passam por rigorosos processos de seleção, treinamento contínuo e atualizações, assegurando que estejam preparados para lidar com diferentes cenários e desafios de segurança.

· Atendimento Personalizado: Cada cliente recebe uma análise detalhada das necessidades de segurança, resultando em planos de ação específicos, capazes de prevenir riscos e proteger bens e pessoas de maneira eficaz.

A empresa se destaca por sua ética profissional, compromisso com a qualidade e foco na construção de relacionamentos de confiança com seus clientes.

Com presença sólida na região de Chapecó e Itajaí, a Patrimonial Segurança é mais do que uma prestadora de serviços; é uma parceira estratégica na proteção de bens e na promoção da tranquilidade.

Estamos em busca de um Assistente Administrativo com interesse em se desenvolver nas áreas de RH, departamento pessoal e ponto eletrônico para integrar nosso time! Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para quem deseja crescer.


Atividades:

·        Suporte em admissão;

·        Organização de documentos;

·        Triagem de Currículos;

·        Apoio no fechamento de folha de pagamento;

·        Apoio em cálculos de Departamento Pessoal;

·        Apoio em fechamento de ponto eletrônico;

·        Apoio em ajustes de ponto e alocações de marcação;

·        Apoio em cobrança de alocações de ponto;

·        Apoio em auditoria de pontos eletrônicos.


Requisitos:

·        Habilidades de comunicação;

·        Capacidade de organização;

·        Conhecimentos básicos na área administrativa.

·        Residir em Chapecó/SC.


 Benefícios:

·        Salário compatível com o mercado;

·        Vale-transporte e Vale-alimentação;

·        Plano de carreira com crescimento;

·        Ambiente colaborativo e oportunidades de aprendizado.


Venha crescer com a gente!

title: Estágio em Automação
description:

Você atuará no nosso time em um projeto estratégico, utilizando metodologias ágeis e em um ambiente de inovação.

Você será um pilar fundamental nos melhores e maiores projetos de TI do Brasil e em nível global.

A Minsait é uma empresa do grupo Indra. Somos uma empresa de transformação digital e tecnologia da informação que oferece a seus clientes de diferentes segmentos tecnologias disruptivas e serviços especializados.


Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países , e combinamos nossa experiência em Cloud, Segurança, Payments e Phygital com a tecnologia mais inovadora para impulsionar nossos negócios, gerando um impacto positivo na sociedade. Nosso objetivo é liderar uma revolução tecnológica mais humana.

Nossos mais de 7.000 profissionais espalhados de norte a sul do país, atestam nossa cultura de respeito, diversidade e inclusão.


Em 2023 conquistamos pelo terceiro ano consecutivo a certificação do Great Place to Work Institute (GPTW) , que revela que as pessoas são felizes aqui, graças ao clima positivo que todos nós construímos juntos. Além disso, somos reconhecidos como uma das Melhores Empresas para Jovens Profissionais em Tecnologia , de acordo com o estudo da EFY Tech Brasil, também por três anos seguidos, além de recebermos o selo Bloomberg de igualdade de gênero, uma referência reconhecida para empresas para acompanhar seu progresso na inclusão de gênero.

Vem ser Minsaiter!

Engenheiro/a de mineração, Mina a céu aberto

  • Colaborar com a equipe multidisciplinar de engenheiros, projetistas e funcionários de apoio com o objetivo de oferecer um trabalho de qualidade aos clientes.

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Requisitos

Objetivo da posição:

Internalização e gestão da contabilidade da companhia .


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como responsável técnico e executor das rotinas contábeis, apoiando a transição do modelo terceirizado para a internalização completa da contabilidade.
  • Mapear processos atuais, identificar gaps, estruturar fluxos e propor melhorias que garantam precisão, compliance e eficiência operacional.
  • Conduzir a relação com a empresa terceirizada, garantindo alinhamento, qualidade das informações e preparação para o processo de internalização.
  • Organizar, controlar e validar lançamentos contábeis, conciliações, provisões, fechamento mensal e demais rotinas da área.
  • Apoiar a estruturação das áreas de custos e controladoria, trazendo visão analítica, rigor técnico e controles mais robustos.
  • Desenvolver rotinas gerenciais que permitam maior previsibilidade financeira e suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Implantar boas práticas de governança contábil, assegurando aderência à legislação, coerência entre demonstrações financeiras e clareza documental.
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima ao head administrativo-financeiro, garantindo suporte técnico, organização e confiabilidade nas entregas.
  • Contribuir para a profissionalização contínua da área administrativa e financeira, trazendo visão estruturada, lógica e melhoria contínua.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida em contabilidade, com domínio de rotinas de fechamento, conciliações, provisões, demonstrações financeiras e classificação contábil.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em empresas do agronegócio ou em ambientes com elevado dinamismo operacional.
  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis; CRC ativo é desejável.


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Senior Training Facilitator
description:
Position: Senior Training Facilitator

Sector: Corporate Training – Service, Sales, Core job & interpersonal skills

Company: Global Partners Training, Cambridge, MA

Work Location: Global On-Site/Virtual


Position Overview:

This is an ideal role for a mid-late career executive who believes passionately in the power of relationships, not just to drive business results, but also to make the world a better place.


GPT has active relationships and is chasing multi-year deals with large multinationals for training services in a wide array of countries in EMEA, APAC and the Americas. The company is seeking to expand its training capacity by locating qualified facilitators, to whom the company will provide complete training and onboarding.


This is a part-time project-driven role, and availability for GPT work with reasonable advance notice of facilitation opportunities is required. This is a non-salaried position, and so the candidate should have an entrepreneurial mindset and background. Once a facilitation project is identified, the candidate must plan initially to spend several hours, sometimes a few days, to engage with the onboarding & train-the-trainer process. While there is no cash cost for candidate to engage (GPT invests in the onboarding & train-the-trainer process), candidate must have the financial capacity that allows time for onboarding before facilitation work can ramp to provide income.


Candidate will ideally have a mature background culminating as a senior manager/executive in service operations, sales, project management or learning and development in a B2B environment. Former training facilitation experience is desirable but is not required. Experience with professional coaching is a plus. Candidate should be very comfortable leading highly interactive sessions in both face-to-face and virtual formats. Candidate will need to demonstrate a clear understanding of the application of training to business objectives, combined with the persistence and patience to maintain communications with trainees and bring out the best in each person. Candidate will also have strong references attesting attention to detail, imperative for executing multi-event training logistics.


Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of learning GPT program(s) fully and fluently, including watching videos, practicing solo, doing training dry-runs, responding positively to feedback, learning required technical aspects, executing required logistics, and keeping up with updates.
  • Adhere to GPT policies regarding facilitation work, including timely logistics requirements and data security, as stated in the contract as well as on the company’s internal website.
  • Support training groups, managers, sponsors and trainees in such a manner as to maintain every client as a referenceable account.
  • Professionally introduce and represent the company to prospects, clients and partners. (optional)
  • Provide regular and meaningful insights to GPT regarding training observations, new sales opportunities and potential competition.
  • Support GPT peers in developing a culture of empathy, customer focus, team spirit and fun that values mutual success and the highest standards of professionalism.
  • Balance assertiveness with being an excellent team player.


Requirements:

  • 10+ years in relevant senior management role(s) that gives insight into industry, corporate training and prospective trainees.
  • Strong understanding of the application of corporate training to achieve business results.
  • Desired track record of facilitation in face-to-face and virtual formats or the ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the customer: Technical, L&D, Financial and Executive.
  • Strong ability to facilitate training programs in English and the working local language(s) in your region.
  • Comfortable using technical systems, such as video-conferencing software, digital collaboration platforms, face-to-face systems such as laptop/projector interface, as well as CRM, LMS and other company information systems.
  • Exceptional empathy, interpersonal, writing and presentation skills.
  • Proactivity and thriving in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Autonomy and ability to get the job done without being prompted while managing local engagements.
  • Balancing ambition and drive with a high level of integrity.
  • Fun to be around, personable!


Compensation includes facilitation fees and opportunities for quality bonuses, as well as longer-term opportunities if interested for sales commissions and new client bonuses.


About Global Partners Training:

Global Partners Training (GPT) is a private, fast-growing provider of outsourced training programs to some of the largest global service companies in the high technology, health care, telecommunications, energy and industrial sectors. Regardless of the practical training topic, GPT’s wide array of proprietary training modules and programs deliver exceptional business results by targeting more productive interpersonal relationships among external and internal stakeholders across the workforce (field service, global shared services, sales, product, project, executive), and training effectiveness is demonstrated through an innovative process called Validated Behavior Change.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests

Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.

Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.


Educational:

High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.


Soft Skills:

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

Effective written and verbal communication.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.

Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


The Controller is a hands-on, strategic finance leader responsible for overseeing all accounting operations across the company. This role ensures accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and scalable processes to support a growing, multi-brand food business.


The Controller partners closely with leadership to provide financial insights, manage cash flow, and support operational decision-making in a fast-moving CPG environment. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable operating at both the transactional and strategic levels.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:


Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process for all entities
  • Prepare and review timely and accurate financial statements including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
  • Ensure proper revenue recognition, inventory accounting, COGS, and accruals
  • Maintain and enforce consistent accounting policies and procedures
  • Manage the chart of accounts and general ledger structure to support brand-level and customer-level analysis


Inventory, Costing & Manufacturing Finance

  • Oversee inventory accounting for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods
  • Ensure accurate standard costing and variance analysis across materials, labor, and overhead
  • Partner with Operations to reconcile production, yields, and inventory movements
  • Drive accuracy and functionality of ERP systems, including Katana
  • Monitor and analyze margins by SKU, customer, and sales channel


Cash Flow, AP/AR & Controls

  • Manage cash flow forecasting and short- and medium-term liquidity planning
  • Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
  • Improve working capital efficiency including inventory turns, DSO, and DPO
  • Implement and maintain strong internal controls and approval workflows
  • Manage vendor payments, ACH and check processes, and banking relationships


Systems, Process & Scale

  • Own and optimize accounting systems and integrations including QuickBooks, ERP (Katana), and bill-pay tools
  • Improve automation, documentation, and repeatable finance processes
  • Prepare the finance function for audit readiness and future growth
  • Partner on system upgrades, implementations, and reporting enhancements


Compliance & External Relationships

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and applicable tax and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external CPA firms on tax filings, reviews, and audits
  • Support state and federal reporting requirements as applicable
  • Assist with insurance, sales tax, and other compliance areas


Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Manage and develop accounting staff or external resources as the business grows
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain to provide financial insights
  • Deliver clear financial analysis to support pricing, promotions, and customer strategy
  • Act as a trusted financial thought partner to the CEO and leadership team


What We’re Looking For:


  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • CPA preferred but not required
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience
  • Experience in CPG, food and beverage, manufacturing, or inventory-heavy businesses strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of inventory accounting, costing, and margin analysis
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and ERP systems
  • Katana experience is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to build and scale processes in a growing or entrepreneurial environment
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator

Location: Remote – Sao Paulo, Brazil

Department: Guest Experience

Working hours: Shifts range from 6 a.m. to 2 a.m., with 8-hour shifts. You will work 5 days out of 7 , including weekends depending on the rota.


Reports To: Head of Global Guest Experience / Global Guest Experience Manager


About Us

QIG is a dynamic group comprising three companies:

  • Q Global Network (QGN): A global serviced apartment agency working with suppliers around the world.
  • Aeria Apartments: A London-based serviced apartment provider.
  • QDK: Q Apartments Denmark, offering stress-free beginnings in and around Copenhagen


Together, we provide premium, fully furnished apartments for business and leisure travellers worldwide. Our mission is to deliver a seamless “home away from home” experience with unparalleled service, comfort, and convenience.


Although this position focuses on QDK, there is close cross-team collaboration across all three companies’ Guest Experience teams, ensuring we share knowledge, best practices, and consistently deliver exceptional service to both guests and suppliers.


Role Overv iew

The Global Guest Experience Coordinator is responsible for delivering a seamless, high-quality guest journey from pre-arrival to check-out, acting as the main point of contact for guest communication and support. The role combines exceptional customer service with effective problem-solving, ensuring issues are handled quickly, empathetically, and professionally.


Working closely with internal teams (including reservations, sales, operations, supply, and finance) and external partners such as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents worldwide, you will coordinate services, manage escalations, and help maintain consistent standards across the guest experience. You will also gather and analyse guest feedback, monitor partner performance, and contribute ideas to continuously improve service delivery—particularly for VIP and corporate accounts where attention to detail and discretion are essential.


Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience

  • Be the main point of contact for guests, responding to inquiries by email, phone, and live chat with professionalism and warmth.
  • Guide guests through the full journey—from pre-arrival checks to check-out—ensuring they feel supported at every stage.
  • Manage guest issues with empathy and efficiency, escalating only when necessary.


Complaint Resolution & Escalation Management:

  • Liaise daily with internal department like reservations, sales and operational team as well as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents across the globe to ensure smooth delivery of services.
  • Communicate guest feedback and issues to suppliers clearly, ensuring timely action.
  • Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with suppliers to foster trust and collaboration.
  • Monitor supplier performance and suggest improvements to strengthen our product.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Balance guest needs with operational & supplier capabilities to create win–win outcomes.
  • Anticipate challenges and take proactive steps to prevent service gaps.
  • Work closely with the reservations, supply, finance and sales teams across different regions to ensure smooth communication and coordination of guest requirements or special requests.


Feedback Collection & Reporting:

  • Encourage guests to complete feedback surveys and track satisfaction trends.
  • Share insights with internal teams and suppliers to drive ongoing service enhancements.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations for improving the overall guest and supplier experience.
  • VIP & Corporate Account Management:
  • Handle the needs of high-profile, VIP guests, or corporate accounts, ensuring that all special requirements are met, from booking preferences to additional services.




Qualifications & Competencies

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years in guest relations, hospitality, account management, or supplier coordination.
  • Background in serviced apartments, hotels, or travel services beneficial.


Skills:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and negotiation abilities.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in CRM or guest/supplier management systems.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English required; Spanish highly beneficial.


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic, approachable, and culturally sensitive.
  • Confident in managing expectations for both guests and suppliers.
  • Proactive and adaptable in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Collaborative team player with a passion for service excellence.


Education:

  • Degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field desirable but not essential.


Why Join Us?

  • Bridge Role Impact: Play a key part in delivering exceptional experiences by supporting both guests and suppliers.
  • Global Exposure: Work with diverse clients and partners across multiple regions.
  • Dynamic Culture: Join a friendly, collaborative team where new ideas are celebrated.
  • Competitive Package: Attractive salary and benefits.
